facts.text: Jolene attended a meditation retreat in Phuket with her partner for a few weeks, which included time for reflection and relaxation.

evidence.quote: Last weekend my partner and I traveled to a meditation retreat for a few weeks in Phuket.
At the retreat, I had time to reflect on what makes me happy.

facts.text: Jolene found the retreat to be an inspiring and refreshing experience, particularly due to the natural surroundings.

evidence.quote: Nature, reflection and a break from engineering studies were awesome - it helped me find inner peace.
The beauty of nature there was so inspiring and refreshing!

facts.text: Jolene identified a session at the retreat about releasing expectations and judgments as particularly impactful, emphasizing the importance of appreciating the journey rather than just the destination.

evidence.quote: The one session that really stood out was about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present.
It was a strong reminder to not just dwell on the finish line, but to appreciate the journey too.

facts.text: Jolene expressed a desire to be more mindful and grateful, recognizing the value of small moments in life.

evidence.quote: Trying to be more mindful and grateful to take it all in now.
Even just a different outlook can make the little things in life joyful.
